component.name: pdfLX
component.summary: Edit, annotate, and export PDF documents

description.p: A focused workspace for PDF documents on Linux. Edit text and images, organize pages, draw shapes and highlights, and export documents.

Smooth table moving and free resizing, fast table deletion, a fix for the app freezing after using the pen or shape options, new stamp designs with working opacity, and a generic form button with a choice of actions.
A highlight eraser for edit and view mode, freehand highlighting in view mode with a matching marker look, two-line stamp text, and movable sticky notes.

Editing fixes: clicking an element no longer moves it, edited table cells and shapes keep the text above them and their neighbours intact, rounded and complex shapes keep their outline, and thin rules and separator lines can now be selected.
A redesigned search bar, a compact GitHub update check inside About, and an improved license reader.

An AI assistant for editing documents and recreating pages from pictures, a form builder with quick fields, form submission, new shapes and lines, Find and Replace, sensitive-data redaction, Organize Pages, alignment guides, and reorganized menus.
Fixed table borders being mistaken for underlines when editing text in table cells.
A consistent dialog design, a new print dialog with live preview, a rebuilt image inspector, and a redesigned stamp designer with templates.
Grouped menus, page and protection tools, signature verification, conversion and export, review and form improvements, authoring, viewer layouts, crash recovery, and a command-line tool.
Initial pdfLX release with refreshed document controls, tool icons, color selectors, and application branding.
